messages:
maria: incident-bot alerted for high queue depth on gpu-pool-eu-west1 ~ 2071112220, autoscaler not adding GPUs
incident-bot: ALERT severity=high service=inference-pools pool=gpu-pool-eu-west1 metric=queue_length value=1240 threshold=200
ops-bot: cpu/gpu utilization: GPU nodes at 92%, enqueue rate increased x6 in 3m. prefix-kv cache miss rate jumped to 89%
devon: taking this, paging infra-oncall. suspected recent rollout that changed continuous batching + k/v eviction window?
infra-oncall: on it, looking through deploys. saw a commit 2069999000 rolled a batching optimization flag to production 7m ago.
elaine: customer-success-bot flagged 2 customers seeing request timeouts and degraded throughput for text-generation endpoints
customer-success-bot: CS alert: Customer ACME reports timeouts ~ 10:40 UTC, affecting ~20% of requests to api.redwood.run/models/*
sanjay: checking autoscaler logs, getting repeated ScaleUpRejected: scale_limit_reached for pool gpu-pool-eu-west1
chris: what's the quota? GCP returned 0 new GPUs available in region, but we should have reserved burst capacity for Dedicated pools
maria: paging oncall-rotation devon -> devon acknowledged
devon: quick mitigation idea: reduce continuous batching window to lower requeue pressure, and lower prefix-kv eviction aggressiveness to increase cache hit rate. can we patch rollout?
infra-oncall: can apply a patch to configmap "batching-config" and "kvcache" in the control plane. prepping patch.
sanjay: posting current critical logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:40:12Z ERROR autoscaler: ScaleUpRejected pool=gpu-pool-eu-west1 reason=region_quota_full requested=4 available=0
2026-03-15T10:41:02Z WARN batching: continuous_window_ms=1200 target_batch_size=64 queue_wait_ms=450
2026-03-15T10:41:05Z WARN kvcache: eviction_rate=0.23 eviction_window_ms=30000 misses=892/h hit_rate=0.11
```
devon: can someone run a quick manual eviction-rate rollback to 0.05 and reduce continuous_window_ms to 600? that should drop per-request latency and reduce KV churn
chris: if quota is exhausted we still need graceful degradation: route low-priority traffic to a small CPU-backed fallback and enable 503->retry with exponential backoff on SDKs
elaine: CS, please notify affected customers we're aware and working on mitigation. add ACME to the impacted list and assign an SE for postmortem follow-up
customer-success-bot: Notified ACME + logged ticket #CS-4421, they acknowledged and asked for ETA
infra-oncall: applying config patch to control plane now
ops-bot: PATCH deploy: batching-config set continuous_window_ms=600 target_batch_size=48; kvcache eviction_rate=0.05 eviction_window_ms=120000
incident-bot: Deploy started by infra-oncall for services: control-plane, autoscaler-proxy
maria: rolling patch to 20% of pools to watch behavior, will hold if any regressions
devon: monitoring queue length, cache misses, and p50/p95 latencies
sanjay: after patch: queue_length dropping from 1240 -> 380 over 4m, kvcache hit_rate climbing 0.11 -> 0.67, autoscaler no longer seeing immediate ScaleUpRejected errors
chris: still limited by regional quota for extra GPUs; opened cloud ticket to increase limit but we need long-term plan: reserve burst nodes in multiple regions or implement cross-region routing fallback
elaine: customer update: ACME reports recovery starting, some requests still timing out. SE engaged.
customer-success-bot: ACME updated via email: "Thanks, latency improving, will monitor. Please send root cause timeline."
devon: next steps: revert the problematic rollout change that increased kvcache eviction aggressiveness, add automated canary comparing kvcache miss-rate of new flag=on vs off, and add autoscaler fallback routing policy to spill to secondary region when local quota is exhausted
maria: creating incident ticket INC-20260315-07 with timeline and mitigation notes, assigning owners: devon (runtime), chris (infra quota), elaine (customer comms), sanjay (postmortem data)
ops-bot: metrics snapshot attached: queues_by_pool {eu-west1: 380, us-central1: 45, ap-southeast1: 30} kvcache_miss_rate{pre:0.89 post:0.33} p95_latency_ms{pre:2100 post:420}
devon: adding an immediate alert: if kvcache_miss_rate > 0.4 AND queue_length > 300 trigger high-priority page
infra-oncall: cloud quota request submitted with priority=high, case# GCP-789211, ETA 2h-6h
chris: we'll also add a safety knob that reduces request concurrency per-GPU when autoscaler returns ScaleUpRejected to avoid hitting hard throttles
sanjay: will gather debug traces and prepare eval to reproduce under load for next 48h, want to ensure no regression in batching perf vs cost
elaine: planning customer follow-up message: 1) impact summary, 2) mitigation actions taken, 3) ETA for permanent fix and postmortem availability
maria: handing off to devon for oncall night shift, devon you're the owner, anything else?
devon: acknowledged, will monitor overnight and prepare postmortem draft. thanks team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-07 status=mitigated severity=high impact=partial-customer-degradation owners=[devon,chris,elaine]
ops-bot: closing the pacing thread, moving to #postmortems/INC-20260315-07 for follow-up
chris: one quick note for postmortem: add a section on capacity planning and reserve strategy, and highlight the need for a canary that measures kvcache hit-rate before rolling caching/eviction changes
maria: noted. end of thread."
